rationale: I re-hashed (ae4640e8...) and read the held text of EO 10773 (23 FR 5061, July 1, 1958): sec. 1 defines the ODCM, sec. 2 delegates Reorganization Plan No. 1 of 1958 functions and redelegates earlier ODM/FCDA functions to the Director, secs. 3-4 amend references in prior orders. The held text is truncated at p. 5063, a disclosed lifecycle gap. I read the held full text of EO 11051 (27 FR 9683, signed 1962-09-27): sec. 604 'Superseded orders' says 'To the extent that the following have not heretofore been made or become inapplicable, they are hereby superseded and revoked', listing (9) Executive Order No. 10773 of July 1, 1958; the only savings parenthetical attaches to item (7) EO 10539. The reference amendments in secs. 3-4 were performed and live on in the amended orders, so no continuing force remains in 10773. Earlier acts (EO 10782 and 10952 amendments, EO 10958 partial supersession) are partial; EO 12148 revokes only EO 10242 and is irrelevant. cruden number search showed no other whole ending. This supports a reviewed provisional NO; 1989 'Revoked by EO 11051' is corroborative only. No effective date beyond signing is asserted. The four supporting API ids I also read are not observations of this order but supporting observations in the history packet, checked against the frozen evidence: API:0d7bc1bb8cedb2140f9ce825 is the catalogue note of EO 10952; API:4cd99e59d1d5a1c6eba075b4 is the note of EO 10958; API:ca5f255846d7ecfd41bd2b35 is the note of EO 11051 (the revocation basis); API:cef8b6ae1596dcc753ddcaf5 is the note of EO 10782. They were leads only, not status basis; EO 10902 has no supporting observation among them.
